rules.name: Product Name
rules.requirement: Common or generic name of commodity must be clearly declared
rules.description: Every packaged commodity must have a clearly visible and legible name

rules.name: Net Quantity
rules.requirement: Net weight, measure or count in standard metric units (g, ml, kg, L)
rules.description: Quantity must be expressed in standard metric units only

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.requirement: MRP in Rs., must state 'inclusive of all taxes'
rules.description: MRP must be declared prominently with clear tax inclusion statement

rules.name: Manufacturer Name & Address
rules.requirement: Complete name and address of manufacturer, packer, or importer
rules.description: Full contact details of responsible party must be present

rules.name: Date of Manufacture/Packing
rules.requirement: Month and year of manufacture/packing/import in MM/YYYY format
rules.description: Manufacturing or packing date must be in correct format

rules.name: Consumer Care Details
rules.requirement: Name, address, phone number, and/or email for consumer complaints
rules.description: Contact information for customer support must be provided

rules.name: Country of Origin
rules.requirement: Country of origin for all commodities, especially for imported goods
rules.description: Origin country must be clearly stated

rules.name: Font Size & Legibility
rules.requirement: Minimum font size of 2mm for key mandatory declarations
rules.description: All declarations must be legible and prominently displayed

rules.name: Allergen Information (Food)
rules.requirement: Clear allergen declaration for food products containing common allergens
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) Regulations
rules.description: Major allergens must be clearly identified

rules.name: Batch/Lot Number
rules.requirement: Batch or lot number for traceability (recommended)
